name: John Darwin
reason: Too thin for a full page: his book Mindfulness Based Life Enhancement is sold only as an ebook from the publisher's own site (no Amazon listing found; amazon.com is closed to us by robots.txt), he has no YouTube channel or paid offerings of his own, the monthly Sheffield library sessions found have ended, and what remains are free meditations and courses belonging to the volunteer-run Centre for Mindful Life Enhancement, which he shares with other teachers (contact only through the centre's info@mindfulenhance.org inbox).
